defects.what: The frame is split into three stacked comic panels with white borders (crates in a storeroom, a boy's face, a boy by a stream).
The whole still is a four-panel comic strip with white gutters showing people looking at phones.
Two large speech bubbles on the phone screen hold pseudo-text glyphs, upper right and lower right.
The speech bubbles on the phone screen, lower left, contain Japanese-style kana.
The glowing medallion at the center of the nest has pseudo-text lettering around its rim ('BIA BTEE' at the top, 'D LOVE' at the bottom).
The notebook cover in the center has four lines of large golden cursive that read as pseudo-words, not abstract scribbles.
The open book that fills the frame is covered in big, legible-looking pseudo-Latin cursive lines and numbers.
The tree trunk in the center of the lens has a face with two glowing eyes and a mouth.
Indio, seen from behind on the left, has short red hair with no topknot.
Indio, crouching with the dog, has auburn red hair and no topknot, and the dog looks like a Labrador with two floppy ears.
Indio, on the left, has red-brown hair, no topknot and a purple headband.
The kneeling Indio has brown hair with no topknot.
The man before the bird, lower right, wears a grey polo and has no topknot and no headband, where the shot calls for Indio in a tunic and headband.
Usman has two large upright pointed ears, with no folded ear.
Usman has two large upright pointed ears, with no folded ear.
Usman has two upright pointed ears, with no folded ear.
Usman has two upright pointed ears, with no folded ear.
The front of Usman's red kerchief, bottom center, has a white circular badge with a bird emblem.
The front cars on the left have car-brand-like grille badges and license plates with pseudo-text.
The hall inside the lens looks like a Chinese temple, with a signboard of Chinese-style characters above the speaker and characters on a pillar.
The yellow banners on the right have small pseudo-text lettering.
Indio's red headband has a small glyph-like mark on the front.
The top-left corner of the hologram panel has a small circled 'A' icon.
A looped cord hanging by the ceiling lamp, top left, can read as a noose (added by the conductor).
